_why: Fills in this Alpaca account that MeansRev did not place. They are not recorded in trades.csv on purpose: that file is MeansRev's ledger, and another actor's trades in it would misstate the strategy's performance. Listing them here instead lets a wide-window audit stay honest AND quiet, rather than reporting the same six criticals forever until they are ignored.
_cause: LiveTrader shared this account's credential and ran a market-close routine at 14:55 CT calling Alpaca's close_all_positions, which is account-wide. It flattened MeansRev's holdings along with its own. LiveTrader was retired on 2026-07-30 (its alpaca.env was renamed), so this list should never need to grow.
